disclosure: Specified after the stricter overreaction/flow hypothesis generated zero candidates. Descriptive economic diagnostic, not rescue tuning or release qualification.
regression: Next completed1h open-to-close arithmetic return on previous completed1h open-to-close return, intercept included. OLS with Newey-West lag4 normal t diagnostic; no out-of-sample forecast claim.
benchmark: Unconditional next-hour fade of previous-hour sign, equal notional. No ATR/volume/flow thresholds. Round-trip19bps reserves and1.5x stress. Hourly paired rows retained. Neither canonical scanner policy nor portfolio/netting/leverage performance.
selection: No fitting the trading sign to the regression; fade rule remains fixed even if the coefficient is positive. No positive-year or asset selection.
